pressure.title: Accurate, pressure-independent dosing
pressure.description: A diaphragm metering pump delivers a fixed volume per stroke; flow is set by stroke length and stroke frequency (VFD). The back-pressure valve keeps a steady discharge pressure so dosing stays accurate, the pulsation dampener smooths flow, the relief valve protects against a closed outlet, and the calibration column verifies actual output (draw-down test).

foundation: Level concrete plinth; anchor the skid; bund or drain for chemical / oil spills.
alignment: Skid level; check pump–motor alignment where not close-coupled; supports so piping loads do not reach equipment nozzles.
piping: Isolation valves and bypass for maintenance; drains and vents; correct materials for the chemical; label lines and flow direction.
commissioning: Pressure-test piping; flush; check rotation and interlocks; calibrate instruments; run on water before chemicals.

safety: Bunds, PPE, safety shower; relief valve on every PD pump discharge.

video_tutorials.title: Chemical Injection Skid — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Chemical Injection Skid.
A chemical injection skid doses a precise flow of chemical into a process line.

Diaphragm metering pumps (duty/standby) draw from a day tank and deliver through a pulsation dampener, relief valve and back-pressure valve to an injection quill that places the chemical in the centre of the pipe.
Typical applications include biocide, inhibitor, coagulant, pH and oxygen-scavenger dosing; oil & gas chemical injection (corrosion inhibitor, methanol).

The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Diaphragm Metering Pump 1 (duty): gearbox, motor, liquid end, stroke-length knob, Diaphragm 1 (flexes to pump), Diaphragm Metering Pump 2 (standby): gearbox, motor, liquid end, stroke-length knob, Diaphragm 2 (flexes to pump).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Chemical Injection Skid — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Chemical Injection Skid.
Check tank level and draw-down calibration.
Clean check valves and strainers.
Replace diaphragm and valves.
Watch for loss of prime: no flow. Common cause: air/gas in suction, dirty valves.
Watch for diaphragm rupture: leak detection alarm. Common cause: fatigue, overpressure.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
